name: Tithe
overview: Scripture teaches that the tithe is a sacred practice of giving a tenth of one's increase to the Lord, as demonstrated by Abraham's offering of tithes after victory and Jacob's vow to dedicate a tenth of his blessings to God. The tithe includes the produce of the land and the herd, all of which is holy unto the Lord and set apart for Him. Additionally, provisions exist for redeeming tithes with an added fifth, emphasizing the seriousness of this commitment. This practice underscores a just return to God for His blessings and supports those who serve Him, reflecting a divinely appointed order in giving.
